history.summary: Freehold 1BR (2012) on the Geylang/Paya Lebar edge of D15 at $999k / $1896 PSF, just above the $1825 URA median. The 4.7%/yr URA rate looks attractive but rests on only 6 transactions, so it's noisy; the unit is a niche shoebox in a small development with a weak arena record.
history.rating_rationale: Sub-$1M freehold keeps entry accessible, and the area benefits from Paya Lebar Central regeneration. But the 4.7%/yr appreciation is unreliable on just 6 URA txns, the $1896 asking is slightly above the $1825 median (no value gap), and a 1BR is the narrowest-pool unit type. Elo 918 / 91-219-5 is one of the weaker records in the batch. Freehold and price band hold it at Neutral rather than below.
red_flags: Appreciation rate (4.7%/yr) based on only 6 URA txns — statistically unreliable
1BR shoebox — narrow buyer/tenant pool, weakest liquidity
Asking $1896 PSF is above the $1825 URA median — no discount
Weak arena record (Elo 918, 91-219-5); Geylang-edge location carries some stigma
catalysts: Freehold tenure at a sub-$1M quantum — accessible and lease-risk-free
Paya Lebar Central commercial regeneration and airbase relocation over the next decade
EW8 Paya Lebar interchange (760m) provides dual-line connectivity

agent_evaluation.rental_assessment: 1BR near Paya Lebar interchange rents to singles; demand is steady given the commercial hub, gross yield ~3.6-4% at this quantum. Tenant pool shallow but reliable.
agent_evaluation.appreciation_assessment: URA shows 4.7%/yr but on only 6 txns — treat as indicative, not solid. Freehold + Paya Lebar regeneration supports a ~4% view with upside if the precinct delivers.
agent_evaluation.appreciation_rate_source: Discounted from the 4.7% URA rate (only 6 txns) toward a D15-edge freehold estimate
